description_en: Restores data from a specified backup file to a Tair (Redis OSS-Compatible) database instance
description_zh: 恢复指定备份文件中的数据到云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例中
name: RestoreInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup file for the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473823.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例的备份文件ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473823.html查询
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en:
The restoration type. Valid values:
0 (default): This value is deprecated.
1: Restores data to a specified point in time. You can specify this value only when the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148479.html feature is enabled for the instance. If you specify this value, you must also specify the RestoreTime parameter
parameters.help_zh:
恢复类型，取值：
0（默认）：参数已失效。
1：恢复至指定的时间点，仅当实例开启了https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/148479.html功能时，您才可以传入该值。传入为该值时，您还需要传入**RestoreTime**参数
parameters.name: restore_type

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to restore data. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. The point in time cannot be earlier than the time when the data flashback feature is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 要恢复的时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。 该时间点不能早于开启数据闪回功能的时间点
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
The keys to restore. Regular expressions are supported. Separate multiple values with commas (,).
If you do not specify this parameter, the entire instance is restored.
If you specify this parameter, only the specified keys are restored. This feature is supported only by classic architecture instances.
For example, in a regular expression, an asterisk (`*`) matches the preceding subexpression zero or more times. If you set this parameter to `h.*llo`, the system matches strings such as `hllo` and `heeeello`
parameters.help_zh:
指定要恢复的Key，支持正则表达式，多个值使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
当不传入该参数时，表示恢复整个实例。
当传入该参数时，表示仅恢复相关Key。且仅经典版实例支持该功能。
例如正则表达式中，星号（`*`）表示匹配前面子表达式任意次，本参数传入`h.*llo`，系统将匹配`hllo`或`heeeello`等字符串
parameters.name: filter_key

parameters.help_en:
When you restore a classic architecture instance, you can apply an offset to the expiration time of keys regardless of whether you choose to restore full data or specified keys. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. The instance calculates the remaining expiration duration of the keys at the specified flashback point in time, starting from the specified expiration offset point in time.
This feature supports offsetting the expiration time only at the key level. It does not support offsetting the internal expiration time of keys in Tair-developed data structures, such as the fields in exHash and the skeys in TS.
The point in time cannot be earlier than the specified flashback point in time or later than the time when the restoration task is submitted
parameters.help_zh:
当恢复经典版实例时，不论您选择恢复全量数据或指定Key，您都可以对Key的过期时间进行偏移处理。格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）。实例会将Key在指定闪回时间点所剩余的过期时长，偏移至设置的过期偏移时间点开始计算。
该功能仅支持偏移Key级别的过期时间，不支持偏移Tair自研数据结构中Key内部的过期时间，例如exHash的Field、TS的Skey等。
该时间点不能早于指定的闪回时间点，也不能晚于提交恢复任务的时间点
parameters.name: time_shift
